string.text: Within 2m of a lit campfire, body and limbs heal on separate timers. Optional orange screen tint while body HP is below 100% and a heal is running. Body: 20% every N seconds (applied as +1% steps). Limbs: convert 1 BHS point of existing temp->perm every N seconds on the lowest-HP limb (campfire never applies temp). No caps. Disable Campfire slowly regens life (arti).
When on, heal timers pause if any stalker or mutant has you as best_enemy (including ones that already ran off). Off by default.
Seconds for body HP to gain 20% (30-100). Applied smoothly as +1% every (this / 20) seconds.
Seconds between converting 1 BHS point (~20% on arms/legs) of temp into permanent on the lowest-HP limb that still has temp (20-100).
Orange screen tint while a campfire is healing you and body HP is below 100%.
How strong the orange wash is (0 = none, 1 = full PPE).
